parameters.query: SELECT q.id AS query_id, q.question, q.answer, q.retrieved_chunks, q.retrieval_k, q.chat_model, q.embedding_model, e.id AS eval_run_id, e.overall, e.relevance, e.accuracy, e.completeness, e.rationale AS judge_rationale FROM obs.eval_runs e JOIN obs.queries q ON q.id = e.query_id WHERE e.overall < 3.5 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM obs.agent_diagnoses d WHERE d.eval_run_id = e.id) ORDER BY e.overall ASC, e.created_at DESC LIMIT 5

options.systemMessage: You are an impartial RAG diagnostician. Be specific about WHICH chunk failed to provide what information. You do NOT hallucinate fixes; you ground them in the evidence you were shown.
